builds.name: Reference: Ranked support core
builds.goal: Reference for Vel'Koz: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ support players use most (1,014 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 49% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A geometric artillery mage who combines spell hits to trigger true damage, then channels a beam from a protected angle. The current support provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Luden's Echo → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass. Arcane Comet keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, Morellonomicon.
builds.summary: The proven support baseline: Luden's Echo → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass, with Arcane Comet.
testPlan: Play it in support as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Luden's Echo → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 49% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Luden's Echo → Shadowflame → Zhonya's Hourglass.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

kitEvidence.formula:
Vel'Koz shoots a plasma bolt that deals [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.9) × AP] magic damage and Slows by [70]% decaying over [1 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2 / 2.6] second(s). At the end of its range, on hitting a target, or on Recasting, the bolt splits and fires two new bolts at a 90 degree angle.

Killing a unit with this restores [20 / 22.5 / 25 / 27.5 / 30] Mana.

Vel'Koz disrupts a nearby area, causing it to explode, Knocking Up for [0.75] seconds and dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage. Enemies close to Vel'Koz will be Knocked Back instead of Knocked Up.

Vel'Koz opens a rift to the void, dealing [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage. The rift then erupts, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage.

This Ability has 2 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Vel'Koz channels a ray of energy that follows the cursor, dealing a total of [450 / 700 / 925 + (1.25) × AP] magic damage over 2.5 seconds and Slowing by [20 / 20 / 20]%. Deals true damage instead to enemies recently damaged by {{Spell_VelkozPassive_Name}}.

Enemies gain stacks of Deconstruction periodically while in the beam.

Vel'Koz's Abilities apply a stack of Deconstruction for [7] seconds. Enemies with 3 stacks consume them and take [(0.6) × AP + characterLevelInterpolation(35 → 180; raw flags preserved)] true damage.

Vel'Koz's Attacks refresh the duration of Deconstruction, but won't add new stacks.

builds.name: Researched true ray
builds.summary: Prepare Deconstruction before R and test the true-damage finish threshold.
builds.goal: Prepare Deconstruction before R and test the true-damage finish threshold.
builds.hypothesis: Three ability stacks trigger AP-scaled true damage and cause R to deal true damage to a recently deconstructed target. Shadowflame explicitly boosts low-health true damage; Cosmic reacts to true/magic damage and can help positioning before channeling. Mana and AP support the preparatory W/E/Q sequence.
testPlan: Required state: Passive proc confirmed before R, target within beam and channel protected.
Record R damage type after zero versus three setup stacks and above versus below 40% target health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missed setup or interruption converts the expected payoff into a short magic channel.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Magic penetration cannot increase the researched beam's true damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Luden's Echo, Shadowflame, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cosmic Drive, Zhonya's Hourglass, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Survive the engage
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Vel'Koz: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A geometric artillery mage who combines spell hits to trigger true damage, then channels a beam from a protected angle. Track research stacks and R true-damage eligibility. Magic penetration does not multiply true damage; a full beam needs protection and uninterrupted channel time. A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
builds.summary: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts.
testPlan: Kit question for Vel'Koz: Track research stacks and R true-damage eligibility. Magic penetration does not multiply true damage; a full beam needs protection and uninterrupted channel time.

Start with the early core (Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: A transformed mana shield, stasis and a spell shield may preserve repeat casts. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Vel'Koz shoots a bolt of plasma that splits in two on reactivation or upon hitting an enemy. The bolt slows and damages on hit. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.

The route fails Vel'Koz's stated kit question: Track research stacks and R true-damage eligibility. Magic penetration does not multiply true damage; a full beam needs protection and uninterrupted channel time.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Defensive redundancy can sacrifice too much damage; this is conditional on real threats.
Full cost 16,000 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Archangel, then the defense matching the opponent. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Banshee's Veil, Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Void Staff are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Attack refresh stack
builds.summary: Preserve partial Deconstruction with an occasional safer attack before the next spell.
builds.goal: Preserve partial Deconstruction with an occasional safer attack before the next spell.
builds.hypothesis: Attacks refresh the passive's seven-second duration without adding stacks. RFC offers a charged attack range window and Lich Bane rewards a preceding cast; Q's slow and split geometry can keep a delayed follow-up spell accessible. The expensive attack slot must repay stacks that otherwise expire.
testPlan: Required state: One or two partial stacks about to expire, RFC ready and safe attack range.
Delay follow-up beyond seven seconds with versus without one attack and inspect refresh, proc and exposure.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The attack exposes Vel'Koz to engage or an ordinary spell could have refreshed stacks more safely.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: An attack refresh is not a new Deconstruction stack, including repeated on-hits.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Rapid Firecannon, Lich Bane, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
